scope: All473 original rows/12 original fields/all24loci retained. ZL156 is the prospective display parse, not canonical. No IT/RF normalization or full alternate parse.
source_scope: All226 edited words of id00088 and all14 duties; omissions0. C09 and the noted repetitions are paid added synopsis content, so exact source equivalence is NOT claimed.

odeedy.definition: Generic thunder T0, not a dated or numerically measured occurrence.

otedy.definition: First member of an explicitly supplied ordering. Classification and a two-stage conditional sequence are the two declared interfaces.
otedy.argument_requirements: an ordered class or explicit event sequence

opaees.definition: An impression arising from the supplied kind.

ar.definition: Apply the written relational nominal to its written owner/complement; it does not choose an arbitrary relation.

chcthy.definition: Double as the source adjective; no recipe of two named components.

otchdy.definition: Vapour kind. No physical identity with the later storm.

otody.definition: Generation of the written phenomenon in the written medium. No simultaneous lightning/thunder production is introduced.

otodar.definition: Substance belonging to the supplied cloud.

otodaiin.definition: The generic cloud C0 of the initial generation/location account.
otodaiin.binding_effects: introduces C0; not declared identical or different from Cw

opaiin.definition: Bind x to the following complete nominal description; return that reference. Separate lexical scopes have separate bindings.
opaiin.binding_effects: bind x; no effect on previous captured terms

otaiin.definition: Both hot and dry modify the same vapour.

otchedy.definition: Add the following compatible predicate or proposition to the current explicitly headed chain. This is a paid alternative to or.

olkaiin.definition: Move and shake back and forth while fleeing the supplied contrary. The direction alternation, movement, shaking and flight are all paid; the contrary remains unnamed.
olkaiin.argument_requirements: subject x from INTRODUCE_SUBJECT and ContraryOf(x)

odar.definition: Current explicitly bound x as possessor of the following relational noun.

aloees.definition: Contrary of the supplied owner; not assigned a cold name.

octhody.definition: All sides of the supplied owner.

shedaiin.definition: Self-reference to x. In the strike application it unifies patient with the written subject; in nominal apposition it marks the same witness without introducing an agent.

olaiin.definition: One strike event kind. Role application and explicit case instantiation are separate paid grammatical operations, not a silent noun/verb cast.
olaiin.argument_requirements: role application requires agent/patient; case instantiation creates event description with roles to be filled

olfor.definition: The explicitly preceding self-strike is the stated reason for ignition/flame of the following supplied owner. Fire/flame belong to that owner; no friction law or separate fuel is introduced.

daiin.definition: Paid second self-reference to current x.

ol.definition: The written nominal identified in its declared context. It preserves type and does not turn references into predicates.

lkech[ch:?].definition: The ending of the explicitly headed vapour sequence.

os.argument_requirements: following EntityRef; same agent and patient

aiin.definition: Reference to the explicitly bound x in the innermost declared lexical scope.

dar.definition: Later relative to the written ordering context: ignition in the vapour sequence, or seeing in the sensory pair. Neither is an absolute clock time.
dar.argument_requirements: explicit comparison context and current event/access

otees.definition: One informational-witness relation with TWO explicitly paid source interfaces: Authority(actor,content) in G11 and SensoryAccess(access) in G30. G30 alone licenses REPORT genitive AccessRef as a nominal witness. There is no unrestricted Actor/Event/Report cast.
otees.argument_requirements: typed Authority+Content or SensoryAccessWitness; no general source coercion

chcphdar.definition: Aristotle as cited authority, not an independently checked physics claim.

sain.definition: Introduce the strong whirling storm/wind w and its conditional case. The next written entry, increase, sought passage and consequent are still required; none is hidden in this heading. Conditionality, introduction, storm/wind, strength and whirling qualification are separately paid.
sain.binding_effects: bind x=w and wind-case W; new scope

or.definition: Coordinate two expressions of the SAME declared category. Prefix and infix surfaces are two paid syntax licenses.
or.argument_requirements: matching Proposition, PredicateModifier, ReportDescription or AnalogyMap category

qotor.definition: Cloud Cw of the conditional wind case; no equality or inequality with C0.

ary.definition: Seek an exit/passage, without asserting achieved emergence.

dair.definition: Cleave/break the supplied cloud; agent is the explicit subject parameter of the open conditional case.

sheo.definition: Paid determiner interface, same denotation preservation as ol.

oraiin.definition: Cloud explicitly entered by this wind in W, obtained from that written premise. Not a global unique-location function.
oraiin.argument_requirements: WindRef equal W.subject; W.entry binds Cw

chol.definition: Paid genitive marker; same relation-application kernel as ar.
chol.argument_requirements: written relational nominal and matching owner

ockhdar.definition: Emerge from the entered cloud in the open W case.
ockhdar.argument_requirements: W.subject and W.enteredCloud; entry premise required

shoral.definition: Break the parts of the supplied cloud, preserving that cloud as part owner.

roseer.definition: The Cw introduced by qotor in W.

pchedeey.definition: The dreadful auditory consequence of W.r. This is a declared projection from the written rupture witness, not a storm entering ears.
pchedeey.binding_effects: introduces noise nW owned by W.r

qokedy.definition: Ears of each of the two written recipient kinds.

chotey.definition: Declare the supplied noisy consequence unsurprising under the following explicitly compared example.

oteey.definition: Introduce the complete following argument as explanatory consideration; no extra fact or owner is supplied.

oloqorain.definition: A light bladder B and explicit x binding for the conditional example. Not an observed trial.

qotaiin.definition: A supplied subject produces loud noise under the written conditional guard.
qotaiin.binding_effects: introduces conditional noise nB owned by B

tchedy.definition: Restrict the supplied claim to the following complete antecedent.

qotchdy.definition: Strong inflation of the explicit bladder subject.

chckhey.definition: The following event succeeds the explicitly preceding inflation.

ytchedy.definition: Violent breaking of the same B.

qodar.definition: Compare the explicitly introduced bladder-noise claim with the following cloud-noise description. This is a rupture/noise analogy, not access order.

qotedar.definition: Noise belonging to the supplied rupture witness.

qotchd.definition: The rupture of the supplied cloud inside W, already introduced by shoral.

qotom.definition: Paid reference to Cw; not the bladder.

soiis.definition: Concession linking lightness with the guarded loud-noise claim; no inference light implies quiet is asserted.

chok{co}m.definition: Light bladder, in the source mass/weight sense; not luminosity.

otchs.definition: Accompaniment of the two supplied phenomena. No identity or exact production-time equation.
otchs.binding_effects: introduces weather case C; O is an explicit pending observer slot, not a default person

shedor.definition: The generic thunder T0 introduced in C01. This is an explicit co-reference choice, not an equation of thunder and lightning.

chey.definition: Complete the explicitly supplied predication/description. The accompaniment and faculty-comparison interfaces are declared.
chey.argument_requirements: matching subject and predicate or accompaniment frame

sorain.definition: Lightning L in C; bind x=L in the visual branch.

shedy.definition: Paid reference to the innermost explicitly bound x. It does not choose a new owner.

tedy.definition: Visual access to the supplied object; observer remains a REQUIRED argument until the written owner phrase closes the pair.

sodaiiin.definition: Earlier member of the explicitly completed visual/auditory pair.

chy.definition: The following property is the stated historical reason for earlier seeing.

chz[s:r].definition: Brightness of lightning, distinct from bladder lightness.

arody.definition: Paid copula alternative; does not add a new sense.

ypshedy.definition: Return thunder T0 and bind x=T0 in the auditory branch. This is a paid co-referring name plus a new lexical scope, not a new thunder occurrence.

chedy.definition: Auditory access to the supplied auditory object.

am.definition: The following faculty comparison is the given reason for the sensory order/later hearing.

qodaiin.definition: Sight faculty of the explicitly bound observer of the active perception case. The observer must be supplied in writing; delayed binding is allowed only within the whole fixed case.
qodaiin.argument_requirements: case observer O bound before case closes

odain.definition: Greater subtlety of sight than hearing, as a historical claim.

an.definition: Hearing faculty of the same explicitly completed sensory pair.

orar.definition: The two following terms supply observer and ear kind. This overt construction assigns O to BOTH access templates in the paired comparison.

oldar.definition: The unspecified community referred to as our; not a modern experimental group.

ain.definition: Ear kind. This word is not a person, stroke or noise.
ain.argument_requirements: owner supplied by recipient constructor or explicit observer-organ predication

okees.definition: Open a case specified by an EventKind or an explicitly named existing case. These are two paid constructor interfaces. No analogy is asserted merely by this heading.
okees.binding_effects: new strike case K for EventKind; otherwise enter named C without creating a new event

qokal.definition: Earlier access relative to the pair explicitly completed in K. A second use is a referential repetition of that same already written order, not an independent case.
qokal.argument_requirements: AccessTemplate and K.order with explicit comparator

chdy.definition: Visual access to the current written event by the supplied observer.

sary.definition: Generic observing person O_K. Not equated with the later tree-hewer.

qokshedy.definition: Supply the second access term of the earlier/later comparison.

qodain.definition: Noise belonging to the stroke E explicitly instantiated at this K heading. It is not a new stroke.
qodain.binding_effects: reads K.E; introduces nE with owner E

chckhy.definition: The supplied reference is observer of the auditory access.

ykeedy.definition: The observer introduced by sary in K.

ckhed[a:y].definition: The already introduced generic stroke occurs within the illustration. No second physical blow is introduced.

olchey.definition: The supplied organ kind belongs to the explicitly introduced K observer. This added, redundant ear-ownership statement is paid; it does not identify observer with hewer.

qokeody.definition: Attach human agent h to the written stroke E, bind x=h only in the relative action clause, and associate E with that written hewing action. The agent, action and tree are not all hidden in this word: the action and tree must follow explicitly.
qokeody.binding_effects: bind local x=h; set Agent(E,h); local scope closes at the complete relative clause

qoekedy.definition: Introduce the generic tree t of the written hewing clause. Its actor h is separately supplied by shedy in the qokeody scope.
qoekedy.binding_effects: introduces tree t inside the relative action clause

dody.definition: Hew the supplied tree; object-before-verb-before-agent surface is explicitly licensed here.

los.definition: Visual access of the explicitly bound K observer to the supplied object.

qokshey.definition: Map the explicit wood visual access to the weather seeing access with the supplied lightning referent. This preserves role correspondence, not observer identity.

qose?y.definition: The L captured in C. Literal question mark retained.

og.definition: Use the already owned K hearing of the noise of the supplied stroke and compare with the supplied weather auditory object. Requires the existing same-stroke noise witness.
og.binding_effects: reads K.hearing and C.hearing; checks noiseOwner(K.hearing.object)=K.E

lcheol.definition: Auditory aspect/noise of the supplied thunder. G34 explicitly identifies the auditory aspect of an already auditory phenomenon with that phenomenon; this does NOT apply to a stroke.

ochar.definition: Return to the already written weather case C; no new observation.

oted[o:a]r.definition: The thunder T of C. Marked form remains literal.

ochedy.definition: Cloud generation location as a generic restatement of T01, not a new measured weather event or lightning production-time claim.

olchedy.definition: Distinguish the generation account from the perceptual ordering. This final metalinguistic conclusion is an ADDED synopsis statement, not a quotation or new source theorem.

oteedo.definition: Ordering of the two supplied sensory information witnesses, via their retained access events. This extra representation interface is explicit and unconfirmed.
oteedo.argument_requirements: two SensoryInformationWitness descriptions; ordering is projected from their retained access events, not the times of spoken reports

airol.definition: An informational witness of the complete seeing-lightning access from C. It is not an additional spoken report or a new access event.

aram.definition: The complete hearing-thunder access from C. This is a single literal ZL form, not normalized to ar am.

grammar.name: Generic descriptive mode
grammar.rule: The whole account is read as generic historical explanation and conditional illustration, not dated observations or an unqualified universal weather law. This is a paid document-mode assumption. Numeric locus/group order is the authored order, not recovered manuscript order.

grammar.name: Event kind and full role application
grammar.rule: EventKind is a lexical value, not itself a proposition or a concrete event. A written subject frame plus written reflexive object supplies STRIKE(agent=x,patient=x); an explicit CONSIDER_CASE STRIKE introduces a generic stroke description E whose actor/action roles remain due. Complete event descriptions may be asserted only by the stated clause productions. No inverse from an arbitrary proposition to an owner is licensed.

grammar.name: Nominal modifiers and relation application
grammar.signature: Modifier[T] + T -> T; RelNominal[A,B] + A -> B
grammar.rule: chcthy,chepaiin,otaiin and first-class relational nouns retain their arguments and owners. A genitive marker ar/chol/qokar licenses the same relation application; bare juxtaposition of a relational head and its argument is a second paid surface. No generic genitive selects a hidden relation.

grammar.name: Ordinal interfaces
grammar.rule: otedy retains first rank in two written domains: thunder among double-vapour impressions, and inflation before subsequent breaking. These are two paid typing interfaces for one ordinal value; a first event alone does not assert observed performance.

grammar.name: Classification plus generation
grammar.signature: Nominal FIRST RelKind GEN Location -> Proposition
grammar.rule: C01 states FirstMember(T0,Impressions(DoubleVapour)) and GenericGeneratedIn(T0,Watery(Substance(C0))). Nominal classification is an explicitly licensed copulaless production; the generation predicate takes the same written T0.

grammar.name: Introduction and lexical reference
grammar.rule: opaiin creates a reference. When that introduction heads a subject chain, x is bound only in that chain. Its use in an authority argument introduces an authority reference without overwriting already captured vapour terms. Every EntityReference reads the nearest declared x; references are captured, not rebound retroactively.

grammar.name: Explicit subject sharing
grammar.rule: Within the scope of the written subject introduction or case binder, predicate templates all receive that same x. A complete independently headed proposition keeps its own subject. The two cases are separate productions, not a cast from arbitrary data to an assertion. Chains and their endpoints are exactly listed in the manual ASTs; the absence of unique surface parsing is a cost.

grammar.name: Possessor and self
grammar.signature: ITS R -> R(x); SELF(x) + STRIKE -> Strike(x,x)
grammar.rule: odar supplies x as possessor. shedaiin/daiin retain the same x as an emphatic/reflexive reference. A reflexive object in the strike role application must equal the explicit chain subject. Co-referential nominal apposition X SELF(X) is separately licensed before LIGHT; no second agent is introduced.

grammar.name: Causal result and sequence
grammar.rule: olfor consumes the immediately preceding complete strike description in the SAME explicit subject chain and the following supplied result subject. The causal linkage is source content; it does not assert friction. The later quenching belongs to that same headed chain; DAR reads its explicitly preceding ignition as comparison anchor.

grammar.name: End-time adjunct and self-quenching
grammar.signature: Definite(FinalTime) + SELF_QUENCH x + Location + LATER -> EventClaim
grammar.rule: A temporal nominal may be a temporal adjunct in this fixed clause production. It is not an unwritten AT token. os supplies reflexive quenching, aiin supplies x, oteedy supplies C0, dar compares with the already written ignition. Treating ignited vapour as the quenching subject is a disclosed choice within the source's compressed vapour/fire antecedent.

grammar.name: Authority report interface
grammar.rule: otees as InformationWitnessKind is applied to an AuthoritySource and the complete preceding vapour chain C02-C03. It states attribution to Aristotle, not independent truth. This is one of TWO paid REPORT interfaces; it is not supplied by the sensory interface.

grammar.name: Typed coordination
grammar.rule: or admits prefix and infix forms for SAME-category operands; permitted categories are Proposition, AccessTemplate, PredicateModifier, SensoryInformationWitness and AnalogyMap. otchedy is a sequence-continuation marker, not a binary operator missing its left argument. In C02 the explicit hot/dry subject description initializes the predicate context; in C06 the preceding completed W proposition is the discourse context. These surface alternatives, type domains and lexical aliases are paid. AccessTemplate is not a Proposition until required observer/pair closure.

grammar.name: Conditional storm binder
grammar.rule: sain introduces wind w and its scope. qotor introduces Cw in the ENTER condition. The written conjunction also contains INCREASE and SEEK_PASSAGE. All consequences remain under this guard. No equality w=vapour or Cw=C0 is asserted; no inequality is asserted either.

grammar.name: Guard-owned cloud projection
grammar.rule: oraiin may project Cw only from W's explicit Enter(w,Cw) premise. This is not a universal unique-location function or a material-origin inverse. The following break/emerge/part-breaking templates receive W.subject through G07; shoral introduces r whose broken parts belong to Cw.

grammar.name: Noise from the written rupture
grammar.rule: pchedeey reads the rupture witness actually introduced by shoral, not an arbitrary last event or a storm entity. W.noiseClaim is the guarded auditory consequence. Noise nW, not the whole wind, is the ear recipient argument.

grammar.name: Explicit explanatory example
grammar.rule: chotey consumes qocthey's explicit W.noiseClaim reference and the following considered argument. It is not a complete one-word no-wonder sentence. The argument must contain the bladder conditional, concession and qodar analogy; without that body the construction is incomplete.

grammar.name: Bladder conditional and order
grammar.signature: Resound(B) IF [FIRST Inflate(B); AFTERWARD Break(B)] -> GuardedNoiseClaim(nB)
grammar.rule: oloqorain introduces B and its x scope. daiin supplies the subject of qotaiin. qotchdy and ytchedy retain B and their strong/violent modifiers. chckhey orders inflation before breaking. nB is a conditional noise witness, never an observed experiment.

grammar.name: Rupture/noise analogy and concession
grammar.rule: qodar takes the explicitly preceding guarded bladder-noise claim as left argument and the whole following noise-of-rupture-of-cloud phrase as right argument. Both guards/owners are retained. soiis attaches Light(B) as a concession to loudness under the guard. This analogy is separate from access-order comparison.

grammar.name: Weather case and deferred observer
grammar.signature: WITH T IS IntroducingLightning -> WeatherCase C
grammar.rule: otchs opens C and sorain introduces L in its visual branch. The thunder name is a generic co-reference to T0, not a common production instant with L. C has a required observer variable O that MUST be bound by the later literal orar oldar ain inside this same case. No owner is supplied from the source or a different reader.

grammar.name: Property reason and branch scope
grammar.signature: Seen(L) SOONER BECAUSE [Clear Bright x IS] -> VisualAccessTemplate
grammar.rule: sorain binds x=L in the visual branch. ytedar/chz are jointly predicated of that same aiin reference through arody. The clear/bright reason modifies earlier seeing. ypshedy then opens a separate x=T branch; captured L is unchanged.

grammar.name: Weather access pair
grammar.rule: dar/chedy form later hearing of T. The inner or combines two AccessModifiers: the faculty reason and the explicit recipient phrase. orar takes oldar=our community and ain=Ears, assigning O to BOTH templates. Closing C requires all O references resolved and then yields Before(See(O,L),Hear(O,T)), with the two stated reasons. No propagation speeds or numerical delay are inferred.

grammar.name: Faculty comparison
grammar.rule: oteey adds no owner; qodaiin and an use the observer supplied by the same case. chey completes the comparison. This historical faculty explanation is not a new measured causal law.

grammar.name: Case-designator interfaces
grammar.signature: CONSIDER_CASE New(EventKind) Body or CONSIDER_CASE Existing(CaseRef) Body
grammar.rule: okees has two paid interfaces in a tagged CaseDesignator union. With olaiin=STRIKE it introduces K.E and an x reference to that stroke; actor/action fields are due later in the same K body. With ochar it enters the already completed C and does not introduce a new observation. No generic function quotation or unknown operator-as-data is allowed.

grammar.name: Wood access comparison
grammar.signature: E SOONER SEEN_BY O THAN NoiseOf(E) BY sameO HEARD -> AccessOrderClaim
grammar.rule: K.E is the written event from okees olaiin. sary introduces the observer O_K. qodain supplies nE with owner E; chckhy/ykeedy supply the SAME observer for hearing. qokshedy completes the compared access. Thus Before(See(O_K,E),Hear(O_K,nE)); E is not made into two successive external occurrences.

grammar.name: Explicit repeated assertions
grammar.rule: The W20 material is not discarded. ckhed asserts occurrence inside the generic illustration. ain/olchey state ear ownership of the already written observer. The latter is an ADDED redundant explanatory assertion, not quoted source wording and not a woodcutter/observer identity. It is paid as a possessive predicate plus observer reference.

grammar.name: Written hewer/action ownership
grammar.rule: qokeody introduces human h in a LOCAL x scope and associates E with the explicitly written hewing action. qoekedy and dody supply tree and hew; shedy supplies h. That complete object-verb-agent clause closes the local x scope. The outer x remains E. The rule states E is a stroke in that hewing action, not merely an unrelated blow by a person who also hews. This extra action-link payload is explicit and paid.

grammar.name: Referential earlier description
grammar.signature: SOONER E AgentActionDescription SightOf(O_K) -> repeated EarlierAccessClaim
grammar.rule: The second qokal uses the SAME completed K order, not another unmentioned comparison or timing case. qodaiin explicitly supplies the faculty with its written owner O_K; the sight-to-visual-access construction is paid. The event E remains the object; the relative hewer h does not replace the observer. There is no implicit global reset.

grammar.name: Written pair analogy
grammar.signature: VisualAccessOf(O_K,E) PARALLELS_WEATHER_VISUAL L; E PARALLELS_WEATHER_AUDITORY Noise(T) -> paired AnalogyMap
grammar.rule: los/ar/shedy supply the first visual access. qokshey maps it to C's already written seeing L. aiin/og plus the complete noise-of-thunder phrase map K's hearing of nE to C's hearing T. og checks that nE is the noise of the SAME E. The infix or joins the two map components. As both owned pairs have Before, this yields the source's comparison of comparisons. It never equates observers or physical objects across cases.

grammar.name: Captured references and finite scopes
grammar.rule: All references and their introductions are tabulated. Authority introductions, the visual and auditory branches, and the hewer relative clause have explicit lexical scopes. Body concatenation does not silently reset x. No reference from another transcription may repair an unbound slot. Only C.O has the declared within-case delayed binding; all other reads require their listed introduction.

grammar.name: Sensory report interface
grammar.rule: The second REPORT interface wraps an ALREADY WRITTEN sensory access as informational witness and retains that exact access. It creates no later spoken report or extra sensory event. airol is a paid whole spelling of the visual witness; otees ar aram constructs the auditory witness. This cross-domain report abstraction is an additional, source-unconfirmed interface distinct from G11.

grammar.name: Ordering of retained access witnesses
grammar.rule: The ordering is projected through retained access records and must equal the completed C order. No inequality of utterance/report production times is inferred. Both members are the SAME typed SensoryInformationWitness category; raw Event versus Report is not silently coordinated.

grammar.name: Closing distinction
grammar.rule: C09 redescribes the initial thunder/cloud generation through the same generated predicate. It distinguishes that account from C's access order. This is an ADDED metalinguistic synopsis conclusion, not an explicit sentence of id88 or a new causal theorem. It does not assert that lightning and thunder are generated simultaneously.

grammar.name: Complete statement and scope endpoints
grammar.rule: The authored ASTs determine the paid boundaries. No native line ending is an operator or automatic reset. Bare nominals, unfilled access templates and unknown literal forms do not become statements. The grammar can be ambiguous; no unique parse, deciphered syntax or executable decoder is claimed.

grammar.name: Auditory-aspect identity only on auditory phenomena
grammar.signature: NoiseOf(t:AuditoryPhenomenon)=t; NoiseOf(e:StrikeEvent)=n with Owner(n)=e and n not typed StrikeEvent
grammar.rule: Thunder is assigned AuditoryPhenomenon. The weather HEARD(T) object and the later NOISE OF THUNDER phrase therefore match through this PAID law. No identity NoiseOf(Stroke)=Stroke is allowed. The law is an authoring commitment, not independently confirmed word meaning; without it the later weather analogy has an object mismatch.

grammar.name: Introducing nominals versus kinds
grammar.signature: IntroducingReference -> Ref with description; KindDescription -> Spec; INTRODUCE_SUBJECT(Spec) -> Ref
grammar.rule: The lexicon explicitly marks which words introduce references. Pure vapour/organ/faculty kinds are not silently made into persons or events. Named Aristotle is a proper nominal specification whose introduction retains that named actor. Determiners preserve introducing effects and reference type. With a relational head, a determiner decorates that head while its owner slot remains OPEN until the written genitive argument arrives; it does not assert an unowned noise.

grammar.name: Explicit nominal-restriction initialization
grammar.rule: The initial additive marker in C02 has this WRITTEN nominal restriction as its antecedent context. It does not invent an empty preceding assertion, owner or omitted clause. This is a paid description-to-subject-qualification interface; it does not invert an arbitrary predicate into a reference.

grammar.name: Generation-description surfaces
grammar.signature: Phenomenon GENERATED Location or Phenomenon Location GENERATED -> GenerationDescription
grammar.rule: C01 and C09 use these two paid linear surfaces for the SAME complete role bundle. A classification/assertion context in C01 asserts generic generation; the distinction context in C09 consumes the description without asserting a new occurrence. The predicate cannot absorb an arbitrary untyped location or owner.

grammar.name: Whole AST fragment assembly
grammar.rule: C02 is an OPEN subject-account fragment completed by C03, not a standalone closed binder. C04 is an OPEN conditional header completed by C05. The actual lexical binders are opaiin and sain, not the presentation wrappers ScopeV/ConditionalW. The nested complete AST carries these scopes; native line endings never close them. The selected body boundaries are paid parse choices, not claimed unique or source-independent punctuation.

V.closure: authority suffix in C03; its own authority introduction is nested

W.additional_bindings: qotor=Cw; shoral=r; pchedeey=nW and guarded noise claim
W.closure: complete noise-recipient clause in C05; W record retained by explicit later references

C.observer: orar oldar ain binds O=OurCommunity; this is the sole permitted forward within-case owner binding
C.closure: complete S17 recipient phrase; captured C later read explicitly

K.x: stroke E from following olaiin EventKind
K.observer: sary binds O_K; ykeedy reads it
K.noise: qodain introduces nE owned by E

Hewer.closure: the complete tree/object-hew/verb-h/agent clause; outer K x=E resumes

manual_clauses.reading: Thunder is first among the double-vapour impressions, and is generated in watery cloud substance.
manual_clauses.scope_and_dependencies: odeedy introduces generic T0; otodaiin introduces C0. No two-component recipe or dated event is supplied.

manual_clauses.manual_surface_ast: (SUBJECT_CHAIN (opaiin (otaiin qopchas)) (otchedy (olkaiin (odar aloees))) (otchedy (qotedaiin (odar octhody))) (ROLE_APPLY shedaiin olaiin) (olfor daiin))
manual_clauses.formula: Let x=v:HotDryVapour. BackAndForthMove(v) AND Shake(v) AND Flee(v,ContraryOf(v)) AND Constrained(v,AllSides(v)) AND Strike(s,v,v) AND IgniteFlame(i,v) AND Because(s,i)
manual_clauses.reading: Hot, dry vapour moves and shakes back and forth, fleeing its unspecified contrary while constrained on all sides. It strikes into itself and thereby ignites into flame.
manual_clauses.scope_and_dependencies: Vapour x introduced at .1 G012; this subject scope continues through C03. olaiin stays EventKind STRIKE, applied to explicit subject and reflexive patient. olfor takes the preceding strike, not an arbitrary prior clause.

manual_clauses.manual_surface_ast: (CITATION (QUENCH (ol lkech[ch:?]) os aiin oteedy dar) otees (opaiin chcphdar))
manual_clauses.reading: At the end it quenches itself in that cloud, after ignition; the account is attributed to Aristotle.
manual_clauses.scope_and_dependencies: aiin is still v. C0 is read from C01. The authority introduction is a nested nominal scope, not a retroactive replacement of v. The vapor/fire antecedent is modeled as ignited v and remains a disclosed choice.

manual_clauses.manual_surface_ast: (sain (or (or (PRED aiin opchdy qotor) (PRED sheedy shodaiin)) (PRED olfar ary)) CONSEQUENT_C05)
manual_clauses.typed_result: ConditionalHeader with explicit Guard and C05 consequent
manual_clauses.formula: In conditional case W: Let w=StrongWhirlingStormWind, Cw=Cloud. GuardW := Enter(w,Cw) AND Increase(w) AND Seek(w,Passage). WHEN GuardW, C05.
manual_clauses.reading: When a strong whirling storm/wind enters a cloud, increases and seeks a passage, the following cloud-breaking consequences obtain.
manual_clauses.scope_and_dependencies: sain introduces w and subject x=w; qotor introduces Cw. sheedy/olfar are paid x aliases. The seek predicate does not assert achieved emergence. C04 requires C05 to complete its conditional.

manual_clauses.formula: Let B=LightBladder. GuardB := StrongInflate(b1,B) AND ViolentBreak(b2,B) AND Before(b1,b2). GuardB -> Loud(nB) AND NoiseOf(nB,B). Concession(Light(B),LoudUnderGuard(B)); Analogy(NoiseClaimB,NoiseClaimW); NoWonder(NoiseClaimW,explainedBy=Analogy).
manual_clauses.reading: The cloud noise is unsurprising in light of a bladder example: even a light bladder makes loud noise if first strongly inflated and afterward violently broken. Its guarded noise is compared with cloud rupture noise; its lightness is explicitly retained as a concession.
manual_clauses.scope_and_dependencies: oloqorain binds x=B. This is conditional, not an observed trial. qodar consumes the preceding guarded nB claim and the explicit following nW description. W.r/Cw remain captured references outside the B scope. This is not a sensory-order replication.

manual_clauses.formula: Accompany(L,T0). Let O=OurCommunity, aV=See(O,L), aA=Hear(O,T0). Before(aV,aA). Because(Clear(L) AND Bright(L),Earlier(aV,aA)); Because(Subtler(Sight(O),Hearing(O)),Later(aA,aV)).
manual_clauses.reading: Lightning accompanies thunder. It is seen sooner because it is clear and bright; thunder is heard later, with the comparative subtlety of sight over hearing offered as the reason. Our community owns the two access relations and its ears are the auditory recipients.
manual_clauses.scope_and_dependencies: The visual x=L and auditory x=T0 are separate lexical branches. orar oldar ain is the actual observer-binding phrase; no owner is filled from the source or from another reader. All references to C.O remain provisional until this phrase completes the case. Accompaniment does not establish an identical production instant.

manual_clauses.reading: A person sees a stroke before hearing the noise of that same stroke. The stroke belongs to the explicitly described person hewing a tree. The observer remains a separate role. The passage reiterates the stroke and ear ownership, then explicitly maps its seeing and hearing to the lightning/thunder pair.

revision_history_before_freeze.change: Prospective source allocation: initial annulus classification/vapour; N and E7 wind; remaining E bladder; S weather access; W wood access/analogy; final annulus summary. No figure labels or source-defined fourfold map.

Explored d/qo as sound/owned-aspect operations over named or changing owners and possible ar/aiin/ain reference roots. First annular references and the later ear/faculty uses did not supply one fixed typed interface. No cut or component value was retained.

Under the actual whole candidate, qod|aiin would have to yield observer sight from a changing subject reference, while qod|ain would have to yield stroke noise from EAR-kind. A common operator cannot be obtained from these two outputs without additional input-specific lookup or context repair. qodar also remains LIKE. These are opaque paid wholes, not a claimed qod family.
olaiin kept one STRIKE EventKind value. Explicit role application for the vapour and explicit case instantiation for the wood example replace an unannounced noun/verb cast.

Current-subject references became lexical-scope references with explicit introductions, captures and endpoints. No implicit global subject switching remains authorized. The hewer local x closes after TREE HEW x and restores the outer stroke reference by lexical scope, not a new reset word.

FIRST has classification and conditional-sequence interfaces; coordinate has prefix/infix surfaces; nominal relation application has marked and unmarked surfaces. These are syntax costs, not manuscript discoveries.
The second qokal re-describes the SAME completed K comparison. It is not an independent sensory case and cannot use an unbound comparison partner.
Authority attribution and sensory information witnesses are separately specified. The final summary is not read as two spoken reports made at different times.

The tail initially mixed a raw visual access with an auditory information witness. airol is now explicitly a paid whole visual information witness so the pair has one type; G31 projects its retained access ordering. No silent Event/Report cast remains claimed.

The later NOISE OF THUNDER phrase otherwise differed from the earlier HEARD(THUNDER) object. G34 explicitly makes NOISE_OF the identity on an already auditory phenomenon, while keeping a stroke distinct from its noise. This is a new authoring assumption, not source-confirmed morphology.

The W ear-ownership repetition and closing generation/access distinction are not literal source sentences. They are added synopsis assertions. The authority/sensory-report abstraction, ear predicate and closure are the weakest motivated additions.

All introducing nominal references were distinguished from pure kind specifications. Tree introduction, lightning/thunder branch binding, and relation-head determiners are explicit; no new literal aliases were added for other readers.

Explicitly included AccessTemplate in the finite coordination domains, distinguished additive sequence continuation from binary coordinate, and paid initialization of the first vapour predicate context from the written hot/dry nominal. Parametric reference lookups preserve referent sorts rather than casting Events into Persons.

The two generation surfaces were explicitly licensed and REPORT was typed as a relational witness kind with exactly the two already paid construction interfaces. These clarifications are included in the first freeze, not retrospective repairs.
The whole scoped AST explicitly joins C02/C03 under the actual opaiin binder and C04/C05 under sain. Individual display fragments are not misrepresented as independently closed scopes.

type_interfaces.reference: Ref[T] retains its tagged referent sort. READ_X and SELF_X are parametric lookup operations over the explicitly typed binder, not per-occurrence sense changes or Event/Person casts.
type_interfaces.nominals: Pure KindSpec is distinct from Ref[T]. Only marked IntroducingReference lexical constructors or opaiin introduce a witness. Tree, cloud, lightning, observer and bladder introductions are listed. A determiner preserves type/arity.
type_interfaces.event_kind: EventKind STRIKE is data usable only through the declared role-application or case-instantiation constructors; it is not silently asserted or read as a concrete event.
type_interfaces.case: Finite case records W,C,K,B and the vapour subject sequence have exactly the fields listed in the scope/grammar. The literal heads introduce them. No unknown token receives a hidden control effect.
type_interfaces.observer: Observer is a tagged human-community or human-person reference. C.O is explicitly OUR; K.O is explicitly A_PERSON. No equality with hewer h is asserted.
type_interfaces.pending: Only C.O may be bound later within the same C AST. Every other lookup has its listed introduction; all C.O uses must be resolved at case closure.
type_interfaces.noise: AuditoryPhenomenon thunder is already auditory. G34 is an explicit paid fixed point NoiseOf(T)=T only for that sort. A StrikeEvent and its NoiseRef remain differently typed, with written ownership.
type_interfaces.reports: InformationWitnessKind has two paid construction interfaces. A sensory witness retains its access event and has no new speech/report time. Authority attribution does not inherit that timing projection.
type_interfaces.event_assertion: Complete EventDescription is distinct from EventClaim. Only the stated assertion/classification/guard productions assert it. C09 uses a generation description as an object of a metalinguistic distinction.
type_interfaces.unknown: An unassigned alternate literal has no value, binding, reset, coercion or alias. A matching following form cannot borrow a ZL reference.
